about_the_game:
Paradise: Musubi is the first of two fandiscs of the hit Boys Love visual novel Paradise, offering the continuation of each of the good ends from the original game with new scenes, beautiful new CGs, and the excellent cast of voice actors from the original.

Plus, once you've cleared each character's main good end storyline, you have the opportunity to revisit key moments from the first game's plot, now with new perspectives. If you loved the warmer, sweeter moments in the original Paradise, then this is the fan disc for you.

Paradise: Musubi gives our protagonist Azuma to romance prickly Mitsugi, gruff Matsuda, and boyish Takara in whole new situations, as well as side stories about beloved supporting characters Hongou and Shimada. Plus, meet a whole new cast of friends, workmates, and family members for our main characters!

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes psychological horror and thriller elements which may frighten players. All applicable CGs have been removed from the Steam version of the game but written descriptions of death remain.
